strings.compare.p.book_on_ug_where: Ku qabso UG halka uu jiro xariiq, Wac hore halka aanu jirin, Liiska ku jira aqoonsi ahaan, Soo socda waxa la dhisayo. Qiimuhu waa qiyaas oo sidaas ayay sheegayaan.

strings.stage.p.like_a_matatu_stage: Sida istaajka matatuuga, baabuurku wuxuu baxaa marka uu buuxo ama waqtiga xadka ah. Laakiin halkan, waxaad ka bixisaa gurigaaga, qiimaha kursigu wuu hoos u dhacaa marka saaxiibbadu ku biiraan, darawalka qaadayana wuxuu horey u sheegay inuu ku raaxaysto waddadaas.
strings.stage.summary.where_stages_fill_fastest: Halka istaajyadu ugu dhaqso buuxaan <small>Pulse · kuraas la bixiyay, magaalo kasta</small>
strings.stage.p.every_corridor_also_has: Waddo kastaa waxay sidoo kale leedahay basas. Isbarbardhig waqtiyada bixitaanka shirkadaha oo dhan, arag istaajka aad ka bixi doonto, kuna qabso UG halka shirkaddu aqbasho qabsashada internetka. Halka aanay aqbalin, waan kuu sheegaynaa oo waxaan ku siinaynaa nambarka aad wacdo, halkii aan ku siin lahayn badhan aan shaqaynayn.
strings.stage.p.every_rental_with_driver: Baabuur kasta oo la kiraysto oo darawal leh iyo safar kasta oo la wadaago wuxuu leeyahay dariiq laabasho. Marka safarka baxa la qabsado, kuraasta laabashada ayaa iibka gala.
strings.stage.summary.post_a_trip_of: Dhig safarkaaga, ama arag qiimaha kursiga <small>Pool · kooxdaada, qiimaha runta ah ee waddada oo kuraasta lagu qaybiyay</small>
strings.stage.h3.offer_a_seat_or: Bixi kursi, ama arag inta kursigu qiimo lahaan lahaa
strings.stage.p.posted_trips_live_only: Safarrada la dhigay waxay ku jiraan browserkan oo keliya ilaa aad gasho. Pool waxay raacdaa hab isku mid ah: xisaabaadka taleefanka lagu xaqiijiyay, sheeko safarka, iyo qiimayn labada dhinac ah, iyo kooxo si aad ula safarto dad aad qayb ahaan taqaanid.
strings.rent.p.self_drive_by_the: Naftaada wad maalintii, darawal saacaddii, ama kooxda Signature marka imaanshuhu yahay ujeeddada. Qiimuhu waa qofkii marka la qaybiyo.
strings.deliver.h2.send_the_thing_any: Dir shayga. Cabbir kasta, meel kasta.
strings.deliver.p.every_courier_in_town: Dhammaan qaadayaasha magaalada hal shaashad, oo la kala horreeyay. Gobollada, xirmadu waxay ku raacdaa sanduuqa baabuurka istaajka rubuc kursi, xilliga goosashadana minibus, pickup ama gaari weyn oo darawal leh.
strings.deliver.span.bulky_needs_a_car: Weyn · baabuur ayay u baahan tahay
strings.deliver.p.courier_rates_are_ug: Qiimaha qaadayaashu waa qiyaasaha UG ee ka soo baxay hab la daabacay; 8 to 8 ee Jinja waxaa lagu magacaabay warqadda aasaasaha, qiimahoodana waa qiyaas. Xirmada Istaajka waa qiimaha UG: rubuc kursi istaajkaas, oo darawalka la siiyo kuraasta la socda.
strings.explore.h2.the_whole_park_weekend: Wiigga beerta oo dhan, hal tiro.
strings.explore.p.park_entry_permits_vehicle: Gelitaanka beerta, oggolaanshaha, lacagta baabuurka, hoyga, lacagta cuntada iyo waddada, dhammaan waxaa loo xisaabiyay muwaadiniinta Bariga Afrika, ajaaniibta halkan degan iyo martida. Muwaadiniinta Bariga Afrika waxay bixiyaan qiimaha Bariga Afrika.
strings.explore.summary.chain_a_whole_day: Isku xir maalin dhan <small>Hustle Mode · qayb kastaa waxaa lagu qiyaasay dariiqa ugu jaban; jeebka iyo qorshayaashu waa tijaabo</small>

strings.drive.p.no_posting_no_waiting: Wax dhigid ma jirto, sugid istaajka ma jirto, tartan ma jirto. Khariidadda raaxadaadu waa waxa keliya ee aad ilaalinayso: saldhigga, masaafada, waddooyinka, saacadaha, iyo waxa aad diidayso. Safarrada la bixiyay waxay yimaadaan lacagtu ku jirto.
strings.drive.summary.where_demand_is_coming: Halka baahidu ka imanayso usbuucan <small>Foresight · goosasho, munaasabado iyo dhacdooyin, usbuuc hore, nooca baabuurka</small>
strings.drive.p.promise_to_be_there: Ballanqaad inaad joogi doonto, farqigana wuu u xirmaa dhammaan. Kalsoonida waxaa lagu muujiyaa calaamad kasta; xilliyadu waa xeer ilaa goosashada koowaad ay bartaan.
strings.drive.span.confidence_is_shown_per: Kalsoonida waxaa lagu muujiyaa calaamad kasta; xilliyadu waa xeer ilaa ay jiraan safarro buuxa oo laga barto.

strings.install.p.one_link_on_the: Hal xiriiriye internetka iyo taleefanka: isla xisaab, isla istaajyo, isla Calaamad shaashadda hore. Dukaan looma tago.
strings.install.p.scan_with_the_camera: Ku akhri kaamirada. Koodku wuxuu furaa isla xiriiriyahaas; ku gal isla nambar, wax kastaana halkan bay joogaan.
strings.install.p.ride_pool_rent_deliver: Raac. Wadaag. Kirayso. Dir. Suuqa dhaqdhaqaaqa Uganda ee dadka meelo ay tagaan leh iyo miisaaniyad la ixtiraamo.

Noo sheeg waxa ku caawin lahaa: hello@ug.example.
strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Magaalo kasta oo khariidadda ku taal waa waddo ka baxaysa Kampala waana istaajkeeda gaarka ah. Halka app maxalli ah uu horey uga shaqeeyo, UG waxay u dhiibtaa safarka ugu dambeeya halkii ay iska dhigi lahayd inay halkaas joogto.
strings.ops.div.plug_ins_ug_talks: Ku darsiyada · UG waxay la hadashaa qalabka aad isticmaasho
strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Khariidado Felt. Shaqooyin cimilo Infrared City. Madadaalo Tazama. Xakameyn cod Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Ku darsi kastaa wuxuu leeyahay halkiisa iyo furihiisa, waxayna ku hadhaan qalabkan ilaa aad gasho. Ku xir mid, badhamada la xiriirana way furmayaan Pool, Sahamin iyo Hustle Mode. Waxba kama baxaan UG adigoon furin.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Kuwa aan la tartanno si ula kac ah ayaa liiska loogu daray. Rakaabka aamina isbarbardhigga ayaa ku soo noqda pool iyo kirada.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG marka hore waa suuq. App-yada safarku waxay helaan qabsasho buuxa oo aan lacag raadin ku bixin. Meelaha baabuurta la kiraysto waxay helaan kiraystayaal la baaray. Hoteellada waxay helaan kooxo maalin la yaqaan imanaya. Darawalladu waxay helaan waddo buuxda ka hor inta aanay bixin.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Darawallo iyo taarikho la xaqiijiyay, badhan gargaar oo safarka dhexdiisa meesha aad joogto la wadaaga qof aad dooratay, koofiyado boodha wadaagga ah oo dhan, iyo rasiid shilin kasta.
strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Toban boqolkiiba pool, qiime hal mar ah oo diiwaangelinta kirada, lacag bixin usbuuc kasta MoMo iyada oo loo marayo Flutterwave, iyo macaamiil aadan xayaysiin u baahnayn.
strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Xiriiriyayaal furaya app-kaaga oo halka laga qaado iyo halka la geynayo buuxsan. Weligeen ma tusno qiime aanan si furan u xisaabin, habkana waa la daabacay.

note: A full working Somali translation of the interface, plain and transactional. Carried for travellers from the Horn and for Kampala's Somali community in Kisenyi. Written by UG rather than by a first-language speaker; the correction button is on every screen.
